Definition: {the back of the neck (as that on which burdens are bound)}
BiblicalUsage: tsavvaʼr is the word for the back of the neck. It appears 4 times in Scripture, including Daniel 5:7 and Daniel 5:29.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gave us tsavvaʼr because the idea it carries belongs in His Word.
